new.s: The provision requiring the State Legislature to express its views on an Article 3 Bill within a period specified by the President was added by the
new.x: The time limit for the affected State Legislature to express its views on an Article 3 Bill was added by the 5th Amendment, 1955. The 1st Amendment (1951) dealt with other matters, the 7th Amendment (1956) implemented the States reorganisation, and the 36th Amendment (1975) made Sikkim a State.
new.tq: Art 3 reference time limit = 5th Amendment 1955; views are still not binding.

new.x: Telangana was formed on 2 June 2014 under the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014, as the 29th State. The other dates are distractors: 1 November is the old AP formation day and 2 October is Gandhi Jayanti.
